page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. The single-core performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25% of tested instances, with single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, consistently achieve average tier results. Memory bandwidth tests also demonstrate average performance, with cached read speeds of 658.37 GB/sec and uncached write speeds of 55.65 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.sn2.3xlarge is its lower single-threaded efficiency, which limits its suitability for serialized computing tasks. However, its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio offer stable resource density for multi-threaded operations. This hardware profile is appropriate for workloads such as static web serving, database operations, and moderate multi-threaded compilation tasks, where parallel processing can offset the lower single-core clock speed.
